title: SAM 3.1 protected-subject background mask
description: Track a named foreground subject locally and invert its mask so the background can be edited. Review the tracked boundaries before using the result for video editing.

requirements.instructions: Use the ComfyUI core InvertMask node.

evidence: Derived from the existing pinned SAM 3.1 video-tracking graph. InvertMask changes subject-white masks to background-white masks; the existing source-linked review gate remains mandatory. Qualification evidence is recorded separately.
